name: real-time-chat-app
description: One-to-one real-time chat and calling web application.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @chat/contracts && concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @chat/web" "npm run dev -w @chat/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chat/contracts && npm run build -w @chat/api && npm run build -w @chat/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run start -w @chat/web" "npm run start -w @chat/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @chat/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @chat/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @chat/api && npm run typecheck -w @chat/web
